title: About me
text:
Goals
I am a huge animal lover, and really interested in working with animals or researching them in the future. I also have a strong interest in education, and have spent my last three summers working at summer camps, along with taking classes in outdoor education. Last summer I also interned at the Wildlife Learning Center, a rescue for animals that are deemed non-releasable. I loved my experience, and included some of my favorite “coworkers” below.
Kona- Melanistic Red Fox  Sweetcheeks- Red Tegu

title: About me
text:
Concerts
I love concerts, and I try to go to as many as possible! My favorite is Camp Flog Gnaw, which is a yearly festival put on by Tyler, the Creator at Dodger stadium. I have gone for the last three years and plan to be there again this November. Some pictures from 2025 (of A$AP Rocky and Childish Gambino) are below!

title: Lucia Murillo
text: Hello, thanks for visiting my page! My name is Lucia Murillo, and I am from Pasadena, CA. I am currently working on completing my Bachelors of Science in Environmental Studies at UC Santa Barbara with a plan of concentrating in Marine Science. This website acts as a portfolio of the skills I have gained while at UCSB as well as a view into my life and interests!

title: ENVS 40 Project Proposal
text:
Lucia Murillo 10-29-2024 ENVS 40, Wednesday 10AM section
Project Overview: For this project, I created a lesson plan for elementary school students to learn about tide pools. This included an overview of the ecosystem, information on common species found in tide pools, and instruction on how to explore them in a way that is safe for both the students and the creatures and ecosystems they are observing.
